limitations.quote: The last 0 of a match can start the next match.
limitations.note: The next-state output check fixed the one-cycle delay, but the agent also changed the post-match transitions to support overlaps where the reference returns to idle.
The exhaustive test used a rolling-window oracle that expected overlapping matches, so it validated the extra behavior instead of catching the divergence from the original post-match transitions.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The rejected cleanup command, a patch that failed to match the source, and a retry with an unavailable Python executable all required redoing work without advancing the diagnosis.
